guitar.notes: Jagged Little Pill was largely Ballard/session-musician driven in the studio; Alanis herself plays guitar live but no single iconic model is documented. Original entry reasonable.

tone.target: bright jangly alt-rock crunch with dry strum
tone.profile: bright jangly alt-rock crunch with dry strum
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Boost for attack, an OD pedal for crunch, a classic American amp model (US Deluxe) for brightness, and a 2x12 cabinet to achieve the required jangly alt-rock sound.
